snippet.title: Umineko Golden Forgery Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Umineko Golden Forgery is an unofficial fan mod for Golden Fantasia that aims to rebalance characters and give them new attacks to create a new experience that still feels like Golden Fantasia.
